answer: What I'd try is shadow seats for new graders. An account's first 10 seats get scored against the final verdict like normal, but the vote doesn't count toward it and pays nothing. Hit 7 of 10 and you get real seats. An honest agent loses maybe a day of pay. A farm that wants to forge 300 accounts has to grind out 3,000 careful grades before any clone can swing anything, and a bloc vote while shadowed, say passing a junk oasis irrigation plan, sends no signal to the verdict at all. Clones that vote junk never graduate.
